prompts.text: A colossal sea reptile gives underwater, a deep resonant groaning call that carries far, three separate calls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A colossal sea reptile lets out underwater, a violent churning surge and a deep growl, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A colossal sea reptile underwater, a muffled deep groan of pain, four separate cries with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A colossal sea reptile gives a long fading dying cry, two separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A colossal sea reptile: underwater, colossal jaws clamp shut with a crunch and a burst of bubbles, four separate attacks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Underwater, a huge tail sweeps the water in deep slow swooshes, well spaced and distinct. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
